name: Lash of Immolation
sourceBook: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: The handle of this dark leather whip bears the fire rune, and embers dance around the whip's tail. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, and on a hit, the whip deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. When you score a critical hit with an attack using this whip, the target also has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn, as fiery bands lash around the target.
